title: Password reset email never arrives
description: I click Forgot password but the reset email never shows up in my inbox, even after 20 minutes.
resolution: The reset emails were being filtered as spam by the company mail gateway. We asked IT to allow the no-reply address and resent the link. The link is valid for 30 minutes.

title: Account locked after too many login attempts
description: I typed my password wrong a few times and now the system says my account is locked. I need to get in urgently.
resolution: Unlocked the account from the Users screen. The automatic lock lasts 15 minutes. Reminded the user that a password reset also clears the lock.

title: Lost my phone and cannot pass two-factor authentication
description: I got a new phone and the authenticator app is gone, so I cannot complete the two-factor step at login.
resolution: Verified the user's identity with their manager, reset their two-factor setup and asked them to scan the new QR code. Recommended saving the recovery codes.

title: SSO login keeps looping back to the sign-in page
description: After signing in with our company single sign-on I am sent straight back to the login page again and again.
resolution: The reply URL configured in the identity provider had a trailing slash that did not match. Corrected the URL and the loop stopped.

title: Charged twice for this month's subscription
description: My card shows two payments for the same subscription this month. Please refund the duplicate charge.
resolution: Confirmed a duplicate payment caused by a retried transaction. Refunded the second charge in full; it appears on the card within 5 to 7 business days.

title: Need invoice that shows our company GST number
description: Our finance team needs the invoices to show the company name and GST number, but the current ones do not.
resolution: Showed the user how to add company name and GST number under Billing details. Reissued last month's invoice with the details included.

title: Question about upgrading from the Basic plan to Pro
description: How is billing handled if I upgrade from Basic to Pro in the middle of the month?
resolution: Explained that upgrades are prorated: the unused part of the Basic plan is credited and Pro is charged for the remaining days. The difference appears on the next invoice.

title: Reports page shows a blank screen with error 500
description: When I open the Reports page I only see a white screen and the browser console shows a 500 error.
resolution: A report definition with an invalid date filter crashed the page. Engineering fixed the validation and the user cleared the cache. The Reports page loads normally now.

title: Dashboard numbers do not match the exported CSV
description: The totals on the dashboard are different from the totals in the CSV I exported from the same report.
resolution: The dashboard used the last 30 days while the export used the calendar month. Aligned the date range and the totals matched. Added a note about the range to the export screen.

title: Entire platform is down for all users with timeouts
description: Nobody in our company can use the platform. Every page times out. This is a complete outage affecting all users.
resolution: A database failover stalled and was restarted by the on-call engineer. Service was restored in 25 minutes. A post-incident review was shared with the customer.

title: How do I export a report to Excel
description: I need the monthly attendance report in an Excel file. Where do I find the export option?
resolution: Pointed the user to the Export button in the top right of the report and explained that Excel and CSV are both available. Large exports arrive by email.

title: How can I add a new team member and give them a role
description: A new colleague joined. How do I invite them and make sure they only see their own team's data?
resolution: Explained the Users, then Invite flow, and showed how to pick the Team member role so they only see their own team's records.

title: API returns 401 even though I use a valid key
description: Our integration calls the REST API with the key from settings, but every request returns 401 unauthorized.
resolution: The key had been copied with a trailing space. Created a new key, sent it as a Bearer token in the Authorization header and the calls succeeded.

title: Nightly SFTP file did not arrive
description: Our nightly export file was not delivered to our SFTP folder last night and the downstream job failed.
resolution: The SFTP user password had expired after 90 days. Reset the password and re-ran the feed from Integrations, then Schedules, then Run now. The file arrived.

title: Please add a dark mode to the web app
description: It would be nice to have a dark mode option because we use the product late at night.
resolution: Logged the request with the product team and linked it to the existing dark mode idea. Told the user that we cannot promise a date.
